The existing formal matrix Taylor action is exactly the normalized finite jet of the actual analytic two-mode matrix acting on an amplitude polynomial. Its kernel is equivalent to vanishing of all retained residual derivatives.

The actual determinant has finite analytic order everywhere on the full corrected closed strip. Convexity of the strip and a proved actual physical resolvent point exclude the zero germ; no finite-order premise is supplied by a caller.

The equality holds on the entire corrected closed strip, including its boundary and nonroots.
